subject.title: fix(cli): avoid macOS system CA exit hang in one-shot commands

question: Should ordinary macOS one-shot CLI commands trade the existing Keychain trust policy for OpenSSL trust by default in order to avoid the Node shutdown hang?
rationale: The reported hang is serious, but the branch changes the certificate-validation boundary for existing users; source and automated tests cannot determine whether that compatibility and trust-policy tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve existing trust policy
options.body: Require a design that resolves the exit hang without silently moving existing one-shot users away from macOS Keychain trust and distrust rules.

options.title: Accept an explicit trust-store change
options.body: Approve the OpenSSL default only with clear upgrade communication and real macOS evidence covering both exit behavior and private-Keychain-CA breakage.

options.title: Pause for an upstream/runtime path
options.body: Defer the change if preserving the current macOS trust behavior is required and no bounded workaround is available.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing trust policy
recommendation.body: Require a design that resolves the exit hang without silently moving existing one-shot users away from macOS Keychain trust and distrust rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent CLI launch history is the strongest available routing signal; ownership of the Darwin CA default remains ambiguous.
